description: Shared conformance corpus for the mod expression language. Every case has a name, an expression, an optional expected_type, a world and an expect of {"value"}, {"error"} or {"check_error"}. A world value is decoded with the schema type of the variable or property it fills: a member set is an array of member names, a seat is a seat name, a seat set is an array of seat names, a card is an object {name, properties, tags} and a card set is an array of those. A float may be the string "nan", "inf" or "-inf" because JSON has no such literals. Selectors: self, next and prev follow seat order from "self"; all and others are seat sets; rand and rand_all draw one seat from the scripted "random" list (rand excludes self, rand_all includes it); match and settings are singletons. Values are compared by decoded JSON number, so the text formatting of a float does not matter. The TypeScript evaluator in phase 2b must return the same value or error for every case.
